images.review_method: Latest saved PNG reopened through view_image after the final parent integration change; regular third-person camera after frame_post_draw.
observations: White low step-through frame, green wheels and chain case, basket, saddle and spokes form a recognizable rental bicycle silhouette.
The physical station board and its fixed labels share the same orientation; text does not float through the board.
The player stands beside the parked bicycle; the nearby interaction prompt is legible.
limitations: Oblique viewing angle and small projected lettering limit full station-board text readability.
The standing player occludes part of the front assembly.

images.review_method: Latest saved PNG reopened through view_image after the final parent integration change; regular third-person camera after frame_post_draw.
observations: Rider is visibly seated with bent knees and arms extending toward the handlebar. The visible near-side hand and foot do not show a major detached gap.
The deployed kickstand no longer protrudes under the moving bicycle.
The complete two-line riding prompt has no orphan final character and is separated from the nearest-building pill.
The bicycle frame, green rear rim, saddle and basket remain identifiable.
limitations: The rider and camera angle obscure the far hand, far foot and portions of the front wheel.
The prompt covers a small part of the rear-wheel lower edge.
A passing pedestrian enters the bottom of the frame without obscuring the main rider or frame.

images.review_method: Latest saved PNG reopened through view_image after the final parent integration change; regular third-person camera after frame_post_draw.
observations: The player stands beside the bicycle after dismount, with the parked kickstand visibly deployed.
The return-complete message is legible and separated from the building pill.
The station board remains aligned with its fixed front/back text.
limitations: A retained cyan capsule pedestrian is visible in the background; this is outside the bicycle visual change.
The standing player and camera angle hide part of the bicycle front assembly.

acceptance_scope: Recognizable parked/ridden/returned bicycle and coherent visible rider pose in these three saved third-person frames.
Previously reported kickstand, station text and prompt-layout defects are resolved in these frames.
remaining_limits: These still images do not establish continuous animation quality, absence of temporal bob/jitter, or performance.
Occluded far-side limbs prevent all-angle or complete full-body contact acceptance from image evidence alone.
Hands/grips and pedal-sole geometric checks are separate runtime evidence in native.json, not a substitute for visible contact review.
This is an authored in-game rental experience; the two docks do not represent live official rental availability.
